title: Many Plans at Once: Diverse Top-Quality Planning in Continuous Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.27012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planners for physical systems usually return a single trajectory, which leaves no alternative when an unmodeled constraint invalidates the chosen route or downstream preferences change. A set of plans computed in advance provides ready-made alternatives and warm-starts for fast adaptation, but only if the plans are both low-cost and mutually distinct. Discrete planning addresses this with top-quality and diverse planning, but these ideas do not transfer to continuous time, where every valid trajectory has infinitely many valid near-copies, and existing trajectory planners converge to one or a few solutions. translated_title: 一次获得多个规划方案：连续时间中的多样化高质量规划
translated_abstract: 物理系统的规划器通常只返回单条轨迹，当未建模的约束使所选路线失效或下游偏好发生变化时，便没有其他备选方案。预先计算好的一组规划方案可以提供现成的替代方案以及用于快速适应的热启动，但前提是这些方案必须既低成本又相互不同。离散规划通过高质量与多样化规划解决了这一问题，但这些思想无法直接迁移到连续时间场景——在连续时间中，每条有效轨迹都存在无穷多个有效的近似副本，而现有的轨迹规划器只能收敛到一个或少数几个解。我们提出了 Many Plans at Once（MPAO），它将找到的每个方案都视为前往其他区域继续搜索的理由：它采样未经训练的神经网络，其输出在构造上即满足边界条件；训练来自同一分布的多个网络所共享的修正；存储每一个经过验证的方案；并根据已找到的结果自适应地调整采样策略。
tldr: 该论文提出MPAO方法，通过采样构造上满足边界条件的神经网络、训练共享修正并自适应调整采样策略，在连续时间中同时生成多个低成本且相互不同的高质量规划方案，为遇到未建模约束或偏好变化时的快速适应提供备选方案与热启动。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MPAO, which simultaneously produces multiple low-cost, mutually distinct high-quality plans in continuous time by sampling neural networks whose outputs satisfy boundary conditions by construction, training shared corrections, and adapting its sampling strategy, thereby providing ready-made alternatives and warm-starts for fast adaptation when unmodeled constraints or preference changes invalidate a chosen route.
